summary: Gated self-evolution: policy candidates must pass historical replay → regression check → shadow evaluation → controlled trial before promotion, with versioned promotion and rollback
implementation: electron/learning/evolution/policy-candidate.ts: AdaptivePolicyParams/AdaptivePolicy; PolicyCandidateStatus; STABLE_POLICY (deterministic reference, epsilon 0); STABLE_POLICY_VERSION; PolicyCandidate (replay/shadow/trial summaries, promotedAt, rollbackPointer, rejectionReason); newPolicyCandidate; candidateVersion

electron/learning/evolution/historical-replay.ts: replayPolicy — deterministic leave-nothing-out replay over recorded episodes grouped per task; candidate vs stable selection using policy params; regressions counted beyond tolerance; refuses to pass without a minimum number of replayable groups (never pretends to validate)

electron/learning/evolution/shadow-evaluator.ts: evaluateShadow — candidate runs hypothetically alongside the stable policy (nothing it decides is executed), reporting divergence rate, per-decision regression count and pass/fail against thresholds

electron/learning/evolution/promotion-gate.ts: PolicyPromotionGate — durable gate enforcing stage ORDER (replay → shadow → trial); promote() refuses without replay (A42), with a replay regression (A43), without/past a failed shadow (A44); promotion records policyVersion + parentVersion + promotedAt + full evaluation summaries + rollbackPointer (A45); rollback() restores the previous stable policy and marks the candidate ROLLED_BACK (A46); corrupt store keeps the deterministic stable policy

electron/learning/routing/exploration-policy.ts (fix): exploration now actually SELECTS the explorer (not merely nudging its score) while a pin and AVOID classification still dominate — otherwise exploration would be a functional no-op
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-10.test.ts (13 tests): deterministic replay with no regression; A43 aggressive candidate regresses historically and fails the replay (stableMean > candidateMean); insufficient history reported honestly; A44 shadow regressions fail; shadow divergence rate/agreement pass path; shadow minimum observations; A42 promotion refused before replay; A43 REPLAY_FAILED blocks promotion; A44 SHADOW_FAILED blocks promotion; stage order enforced (shadow before replay ignored); A45/A46 promote ⇒ version/parent/rollbackPointer/evaluation summaries, rollback restores parent and second rollback refused; promotion+rollback survive restart; corrupt gate keeps the stable policy
notes: Addresses A42-A46. The Engine §14 prohibition ('AI says the new formula is better ⇒ replace the router') is enforced structurally: promo without replay/shadow/trial is impossible.
